name: hypertask_agents
does: List owned agent identities, inspect live team presence, or create, revoke, archive or permanently delete an owned agent.
use_when: Use for agent identity administration or to see which agents are active on a team.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for ticket assignees or webhook delivery; use hypertask_tasks assign or hypertask_webhooks instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. Human or management credentials are required for administration; presence requires team_id. Creating returns a credential once, and delete is irreversible.
